A capability that MAKES a component possible is not the component.

So the same family was over-counted by three and under-counted by one, which nets to two -- and that is exactly why a NET figure is the wrong thing to check: had either error been one larger they would have cancelled, the total would have stayed 79, and the file would have read correct while naming three things that do not exist.

THE LIST IS NOW DERIVED FROM ported_mg/ RATHER THAN MAINTAINED BESIDE IT. A hand-kept list of the things that exist drifts from the things that exist; that is the whole defect. 29 bodies, 29 names.

SO THERE ARE TWO COUNTS AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME NUMBER. A component in two

Removing them was right and adding them back is not a reversal of it. A name
